intuition: Every child needs one candy, and each higher-rated neighbor must receive more than the lower-rated neighbor.

brute_force.approach: Repeatedly increase candies for any rating violation until no neighbor constraint is broken.

optimal.approach: Initialize each child to one, enforce rising slopes left-to-right, then enforce falling slopes right-to-left using the larger required count.

edge_cases: A single child receives one candy.
Equal adjacent ratings impose no ordering constraint.
The second pass must preserve the larger count established by the first pass.
